title: Respect and civility
text: Treat members, staff, and visitors respectfully. Constructive criticism is allowed.

title: Harassment and discrimination
text: Harassment, intimidation, discriminatory abuse, and coordinated targeting are prohibited.

title: Privacy and safety
text: Protect personal information and boundaries. Use official channels for serious safety concerns.

title: Appropriate content and roleplay
text: Keep chat, media, profiles, and roleplay appropriate. Sexual or suggestive roleplay is prohibited.

title: Discord, chat, and voice
text: Use channels for their intended purpose and avoid spam, disruptive audio, and unnecessary mass pings.

title: Scams, impersonation, and advertising
text: Never request credentials or impersonate staff. Advertise only with permission or in an approved channel.

title: Eligibility and platform rules
text: WVSRC membership is 16+. Follow platform requirements and active restrictions.

title: Realistic roleplay (FRP)
text: Keep actions believable and acknowledge injuries, risks, and consequences.

title: Metagaming and powergaming
text: Keep out-of-character information out of scenes and give others a reasonable opportunity to respond.

title: Scene respect and New Life Rule (NLR)
text: After a qualifying death or respawn, avoid influencing the prior scene or using knowledge lost under NLR.

title: Random or unjustified violence (RDM and VDM)
text: Random deathmatch, deliberate vehicle assaults, and unjustified escalation are prohibited in roleplay.

title: Combat logging and reset abuse
text: Stay in unresolved scenes. Report genuine connection issues when reasonably possible.

title: Priority and Peacetime
text: Check official session announcements before starting a major scene. Routine nonviolent roleplay may continue during Peacetime.

title: Criminal and emergency-services roleplay
text: Allow reasonable interaction during stops, detentions, and emergency scenes. Avoid baiting emergency services.

title: Vehicles, pursuits, and collisions
text: Drive realistically and account for significant collision damage.

title: Green Zones and restricted areas
text: Players in a protected neutral area cannot be forced into a scene. Normal roleplay resumes when they voluntarily leave or clearly re-enter roleplay.

title: Authorized roles and equipment
text: Use only roles, ranks, callsigns, uniforms, vehicles, and equipment you are authorized to use.

title: Official instructions
text: Follow reasonable rule-based directions from authorized people. Staff moderation and in-character command are separate.

title: Exploits, disruption, and abuse of authority
text: Cheats, coordinated disruption, and misuse of elevated permissions are prohibited.

title: Honest reporting and evidence
text: Report in good faith. Fabricating allegations, falsifying evidence, and retaliating against participants are prohibited.
